reviews.author: Alyssa
reviews.text: I just have to say thank you to Shawn, my car is currently being fixed on and the communication and help this guy has provided is top tier! He has provided so much information on my vehicle that I would never know to even look for as well as communicating any other issues he found while working on my car! Friendly staff and they go above and beyond to find solutions to fit your needs!

reviews.author: Marlon Watkins
reviews.text: Excellent service, trustworthy and very knowledgeable! Had a problem with my AC, received a quote from a location in Indian Land, $2400, didn't trust the process. My wife read the reviews regarding SB Performance and Repair, took my vehicle there and AC fixed, oh by the way, saved over $2200.

reviews.author: Heather Ranucci
reviews.text: Shawn came recommended by a few friends and I am so glad they told me about him. It's hard finding someone I trust with having a lowered car but he knows what he's doing! He did just as I asked with checking everything over, giving me an estimate and not once was he pushy. I got my car back today and I am very satisfied and will be returning in the future. Thank you for taking care of my baby.

reviews.author: Jose Meza
reviews.text: SB performance did a wonderful job fixing up my 07 Chevy Duramax. I couldn't be more pleased with their service, pricing, professionalism, and friendliness throughout the process. Did the engine swap and a transmission swap. Something that other shops can’t do!! They were also happy to do an alignment! I'd definitely use them again. I highly recommend!!

reviews.author: Paige Alisa Photography
reviews.text: Highly recommend Shawn! He was extremely helpful, easy to work with and answered all of my questions. My car was fixed quickly and he recommended a fast tow company when we needed it.

reviews.author: Brian Waters
reviews.text: Wife and I just moved to the area and had an issue with one of the cars. Saw this shop on google, read the reviews and thought I would give them a shot. I was not disappointed. Friendly crew, and knew what the issue was and took care of it with good communication. Did the job at a fair price. Will absolutely go back in the future.

reviews.author: Matt Design
reviews.text: You can't go wrong with this shop and highly recommend. They are very honest, very knowledgeable, and do top quality work. Had my 08 Acura TL Type S Engine mounts, Suspension as well a clutch, along with a tune up completed by SHAWN. You can definitely trust this shop for your needs - their reviews prove it! Will always be my go-to shop for my Acuras/Hondas needs & wants.

reviews.author: Jeremy Hooper
reviews.text: I had my radiator replaced here and recommended my Dad take his truck here and both of us had quick turn arounds and friendly staff with very reasonable prices. Highly recommend. Best prices in town and don't feel scammed like a lot of places!

reviews.author: Andrew Colley
reviews.text: Last minute ride height & alignment dialed in! Shawn knows his stuff, super laid back guy & very knowledgeable when it comes to working on cars. Plus you can’t beat his prices! Definitely the go to shop when I need anything done to my cars.

reviews.author: Kristin Smith
reviews.text: I met Shawn while I was on the side of the road, during one of the most difficult times of my life. I had other circumstances going on, when my Durango overheated. I had put my baby on my hip, and was about to walk across the street to go get tools when he pulled over to help. He helped get my temps down, and had me meet him at his shop. While we were there, we had great conversation while he was diagnosing my car. He gave me tips and advice (he has extensive knowledge of SRT engines), and found that the new thermostat (put in less than a week before this) was turned the wrong way! It took him probably 10 minutes to diagnose, and I had no problems with my car again. I have since brought him my RHD Toyota RAV4, and trust him to always confidently get me back on the road!

reviews.author: John Huffman
reviews.text: Good guys here doing good work for good prices. Will take my vehicles back again. Shawn put the new downpipes on my Explorer ST when most shops won't touch performance parts. He did it for a fraction of what the other "performance shop" in town wanted to charge. Also had him realign the EXST due to the $300 "performance alignment" the other so called performance shop performed and ruined my tires. The shop isn't flashy, but they have everything they need inside.

reviews.author: Anna Deese
reviews.text: Flawless experience with S&B, had my truck in on a Monday and ready to go by Friday with a new water pump etc..highly recommend!

reviews.author: Dani
reviews.text: Great experience with getting my Honda fully inspected and worked on. So my oil leaks were fixed and it has my car running better than I got it! I fully recommend this shop for all your vehicles needs! 10/10 experience

reviews.author: Tyesha Wilson
reviews.text: I had brakes and sway bar links service completed today. The owner Shawn and his manager, Chuck were extremely professional and kind. Shawn was very detailed with his work and I was appreciative of him taking the time to actually explain & show me the concerned areas of my car. He even showed me every time he swapped out the old to replace with the new. And to mention.... their prices were reasonable for honest work. Thank you to SB Performance and Repair!!

reviews.author: Tom Kat
reviews.text: Shawn did a great job with my 2014 Grand Caravan. Fixed the problems quickly at a good price. Friendly, honest, knowledgeable, experienced and efficient. I will be back for mechanic work in the future! Should get 6 stars!

reviews.author: Vicky Fancett
reviews.text: Shawn is awesome! Had a last minute issue with my grooming trailer that needing immediate fixing. After several shops said no, Shawn said yes and had it fixed within 20 minutes for a very reasonable price! HIGHLY RECOMMEND!!!

reviews.author: Lue Massey
reviews.text: Shawn at SB Performance and Repair did an excellent job on my 2013 Equinox's AC system and went the extra mile to explain what needed to be fixed in a way that I could understand what happened. After taking my car to another recommended shop in town for the same issue and not having it repaired correctly, I was hesitant to try again, but I am glad I did. I have the coldest air in my car thanks to Shawn and his team!

reviews.author: Jamilia Brevard
reviews.text: After taking my car back and forth to Ford dealerships and getting answers “We can’t find anything wrong with it,” SB Performance figured out the issues to my car. Shawn was extremely helpful and knowledgeable of my hybrid. My car is driving like new again, and I’m forever grateful. I recommend SB Performance & Repair.

reviews.author: Michael Todd
reviews.text: Great Service! Knowledgeable staff! Reasonable pricing! Definitely would recommend business to others!

reviews.author: Braxton Henry
reviews.text: This place offered amazing service with realistic time expectations and I aim to only come here for maintenance issues. The mechanic Shawn instantly identified and remedied my battery terminal issues at a reasonable price. Definitely trustworthy with your vehicle.

reviews.author: Julie James
reviews.text: I hit a pothole and the skid light and the abs light came on. I needed a new sensor put on. Chuck ordered the part and gave me the price which was reasonable. Shawn was a pleasure to talk to. He put the meter on the car and found which area needed a new sensor. He is honest and friendly. I recommend his shop for any work you might need.

reviews.author: Amy Abraham
reviews.text: My experience was great. I'm nervous every time I have to go to a repair shop. But I can say," I've found a repair shop that I can trust." Shawn and the guys got me up and running my car runs like new. If you want it done right let me recommend you to my spot SB Performance and Repair. Thanks guys.

reviews.author: Jeffrey Hinson
reviews.text: I’ve been to other places to get my vehicles serviced at, the care of my vehicle was never taken care like @SB Performance and Repair. Customer service, upfront prices once they determined what is wrong. They’ll call to alert you what they found and then let you determine what or how much you want done. I’m not sure about you, but I don’t like surprises. Especially an auto repair bill. I’ve seen them do all the small stuff,(wipers, tires, and even on my daughter’s car practically a whole new front end suspension.

reviews.author: Lita Brown
reviews.text: Shawn worked did a great job with my jeep. He is honest and affordable and I will definitely be back to get the other issues fixed with my jeep. 1000% recommend him!

reviews.author: Clayton Smith
reviews.text: I have trusted Shawn with my cars for going on a year, and have recommended him to anyone that's looking for a reliable, and reasonable mechanic. His labor rates are more fair than anyone around, and his knowledge is extensive. SB has helped my sister with her 20 year old truck, my wife with her 25+ year old SUV, and my 2018 Dodge and 2018 Cadillac. He has a deep interest to help the people of the town and has been a sponsor for our children's school during their fundraisers. There's not a better place in Lancaster to take your car, than to a local man who has his communities interest in mind.

reviews.author: Sasha Streety
reviews.text: I can't say enough good things about this auto shop! They take amazing care of my 1998 Honda, and I really appreciate all of their hard work. The staff is not only highly knowledgeable but also genuinely helpful and friendly. They always make time and make sure to explain everything to me, making sure I feel confident in the repairs. Plus, they’re really cool people who clearly love what they do. If you want your car in the hands of experts who truly care, this is the place to go!

reviews.author: Yvonne Belton
reviews.text: As Im sitting here and don't know where to start with this business.. Since I moved down here, I never have found nobody reliable and trustworthy with my vehicle until I came here..First let me start off by saying he / Shawn as the owner, is very honest, patient, and he break everything down to you , letting you know what need to be done and how much it may cost. His not trying to rip you off like other mechanical..If you have a problem with your vehicle go by there , and when it time to get fix ..PLEASE MAKE APPOINTMENT, that's the professional way , Your vehicle will get DONE... Let me not forget his sidekick. They both did an excellent job.Very reasonable, on my truck..

reviews.author: Kristin Clark
reviews.text: Shawn and Chuck were great! Shawn had no problem coming to pick me up to get my car which was a huge help! He is very personable!! Chuck in the office was very nice and funny! Great people. Great prices!! Check them out!!!

reviews.author: Leann Travis
reviews.text: I highly recommend SB Performance & repair for all your vehicle needs! Very affordable, knowledgeable and helpful. I’m so grateful a friend recommended this shop 10/10. They are amazing at what they do and will now have my business for all of my and my families vehicle needs.

reviews.author: Samanda Null
reviews.text: If you need auto repair of any kind this is the place! I took my Honda there after doing some research & I'm glad I did. I asked a lot of questions & they gave me answers. Very professional and knowledgeable. They saw the anxiety on my face with having to leave my car with strangers & understood the assignment. They assured me they could get it done in the same day & they did. I've taken my car there for repairs a few times now & every time was a great transaction. This will be the only place I take any car to in the future. Thank you SB & Chuck.

reviews.author: Greg Snider
reviews.text: Been to SB with two of my lowered vehicles and Shawn got them lined up perfectly on his alignment rack. Good, honest guy and fair pricing. Wouldn't recommend anybody else in the area over him.

reviews.author: Jeka Cano
reviews.text: I had one of the best services this morning. Thanks for easing my mind of car problems. Madison offered to reset the screen after the oil change!! And Doug and Taylor listened the worries I had with something under my car.. You guys are amazing and a great team..!!

reviews.author: Chris Wriston
reviews.text: Shawn and Chuck are great! They’ve worked on both of my vehicles and I’ve even sent a few of my friends his way! Got me in and out on the same day! Highly recommend SB Performance!

reviews.author: Eric Sandor
reviews.text: Have taken a total of five vehicle to be worked on and have had absolutely no issues. Very knowledgeable with the ins and outs of many vehicle types. Very friendly and professional shop at reasonable rates for quality work. Definitely a honest mechanic I'd recommend.

reviews.author: Eyeballin
reviews.text: These guys are awesome. Had to have an A/C compressor replacement 2 weeks ago. They got me all fixed up just in time for this near 100 degree weather. Nice staff.

reviews.author: cheyanne booth
reviews.text: Needed a motor swap in one of my cars he was able to give me a reasonable price (cheapest I could find) and got the job done pretty quickly. I’ve also brought over my daily driver and my Tahoe and he has done great work on them as well I’ve never had any issues and he has always been straight forward and respectful would definitely recommend

reviews.author: Andrew Puzzio
reviews.text: Shawn did excellent work diagnosing and fixing my problem. His explanations were clear and understandable to a layperson such as I, and he is a very friendly and approachable guy as well. SB Performance and Repair has my unequivocal endorsement!

reviews.author: Kx. Tao
reviews.text: I recently brung my car to Sean and from start to finish, my experience was nothing short of excellent. He was incredibly professional and knowledgeable, addressing all my concerns and his skills were spot-on, quickly identifying the issues with my car and providing a detailed explanation of what needed to be done.

reviews.author: Caniece Hicks
reviews.text: I was on the way to my appointment and my heat shield fell down and i passed by SB performance and stopped by real quick and they were so kind to help me out and had me in and out in 5 minutes! Thank you again! Y’all are awesome!

reviews.author: Wesley Johnson
reviews.text: My nephew has had to come here three times in the the last couple of weeks Initially because he legitimately had something going on with his car the first time but the other two visits were the result of their poor work. He will not be going back and we most definitely don’t recommend any other families in the lancaster or York County take your vehicle here for repairs. You’re better off using YouTube and doing it yourself!

reviews.author: Scotty Steen
reviews.text: Took my ‘07 f150 in for an alignment after being told by others it couldn’t be aligned without the front end being rebuilt. Shaun put it on the machine and did not give up until he had it dialed in, no parts needed. Highly recommend this shop to everyone

reviews.author: Kelly Dyches
reviews.text: Very friendly, professional with reasonable rates with a great turnaround getting my car back. I highly recommend. Five stars from me.

reviews.author: Breanna Coleman
reviews.text: This honestly was the best experience I’ve had as a woman dealing with a mechanic shop. These guys were professional and honest. I’ll definitely be back.

reviews.author: Amaya Harrison
reviews.text: AMAZINGGGGG!! i drove all the way from charlotte nc . This place was super helpful explained and educated me on what was going on with my car and things to look out in the future JUST IMMACULATE SERVICE!! definitely is an one of a kind shop

reviews.author: Teresa Johnson
reviews.text: Do not recommend anyone going here. My grandson took his truck & didn't get a hundred feet & it broke down on him. This is the second time he had trouble with their work. No he didn't take it back a third time for something else to happen to it. It's a shame how people will do you just to try & get more money off you.

reviews.author: Navi J
reviews.text: Excellent service, I was in and out. My mechanic is knowledgeable about what service i needed to get done. I will come back again and also recommend this shop to everyone i know that needs auto service

reviews.author: Street Frass
reviews.text: I must say thanks to SB performance to do my Engine swap in my car in 2 days..... highly recommend this place!!! Affordable Rates Fast past

reviews.author: Jake Sas
reviews.text: Been here twice and both times it has been great! Knowledgeable, fast, and does great work. I won’t take my truck anywhere else.

reviews.author: Joshua Pauling
reviews.text: Shawn has worked on our vehicles multiple times and has been very helpful, timely, and priced competitively. Thank you!

reviews.author: Madison Taylor
reviews.text: We have been to sb performance twice already. We are so satisfied with the work they have done to our vehicle. They did our alignment and the ac.

reviews.author: William outen
reviews.text: Great shop! They are the best, we will be using them for all our future needs! Thanks for all of your hard work, we appreciate it!!

reviews.author: Joel Burnett
reviews.text: This place is the best around. Shawn is the only person that I allow to touch my cars and family members car also. Will never be disappointed

reviews.author: William Powell
reviews.text: Professional curtious and great at what he does took him my work van and explained that I needed it back fast as possible as it's how I make a living he got it back to me the same day would recommend to everyone.

reviews.author: Angela Luck
reviews.text: Highly recommend! Needed my car checked out and they took in and got me fixed up! Appreciate y'all's help and will be back!!!

reviews.author: Crystal Henderson
reviews.text: Fast friendly and reliable service!!! Will definitely be regular customer with car repairs. Don’t pay attention to the bad reviews

reviews.author: Brittany B
reviews.text: Very thankful for these guys! Quick to determine the problem and get it fixed so I could be back on the road. Definitely recommend!!

reviews.author: travis truman
reviews.text: Cannot recommend enough . Last shop told me my engine was locked up . Shawn looked at it and found a bad starter . Saved me thousands !

reviews.author: Amanda Ray
reviews.text: Absolutely amazing service. Customer service on point. Got my car up and running in no time!!!!! I've brought several vehicles here, and they've been fixed with no problems in a timely manner!!! as far as people saying, only his family and friends are leaving good reviews... if you actually read all the bad reviews this place has, the majority of them are related to each other and speaking on the same incident. Thats never stepped foot on ghe property. If you've never been a customer of this establishment, you should not be commenting.

reviews.author: Novella Kirkland
reviews.text: SB Performance, aka Shawn, has been a trusting repair shop for me. He fix what is needed and tell you what other problems are but NEVER make you feel pressured to make unnecessary repairs. He will let you know what you can or cannot get away not fixing today. I love their customer services and their smile. You can tell he enjoy what he does.

reviews.author: Dean Donley
reviews.text: Another shop told it would cost $930 to replace CV axles and that they were causing the noise I was hearing on my truck. Shawn took about 5 minutes to find a broken brake dust shield was the real problem. He only charged me $65! And that included spending time to reset computer error codes. If you want to find a shop that will really take care off it's customers, look no further.

reviews.author: Matthew Gaddy
reviews.text: I would like to give a big shout out to s&b for putting ac in my son’s 1990 Acura integra. Car is old as dirt but he was able to put some ac in my son’s first car. I really do appreciate the time and patience he took on getting everything worked right. Great staff with good customer service. You can always count on your s&b automotive to get you up and going. The little guy said thanks a lot and god bless.

reviews.author: Harley Anderson
reviews.text: Man idk where to start, I called for a late end of the day alignment after spending 5 hours at another tire/alignment shop getting tires put on and needing an alignment as well, they(the other shop) could only do the tires because the alignment guy had called out this morning. So I called SB Performance & Repair around 4 o'clock to try and set up an alignment; and they went above and beyond to try and get me fixed up today before my vacation. Very friendly, professional, and hospitable, even offered me something to drink while I waited. These are some guys you can trust with your vehicle and they truly want to help get you right. Thank yall, I will definitely be back in the future!
